findings.classification: conditional source-level admission and capability policy question; no accepted unique count or supported runtime claim
findings.first_contract: The public melee capability maps a holding side to required arms and treats the first health value <= 0.0 as disabled; otherwise it returns Available. PlayerBody::body_part_health returns an unconstrained f32, and public CombatBody.health exposes an f32 array. If the selected arm health is NaN, the ordered comparison <= 0.0 is false, so that selected arm is not rejected by this predicate. No malformed body or fixture was constructed or executed.
findings.conditions_and_limits: A supported producer must admit a nonfinite arm value to the action capability and the desired invalid-input policy must require rejection or an explicit error for this to become a product defect. The code alone does not establish NaN reaches supported tactical/autoresolve state, proves no whole-state admission, implies zero health is valid, or decides whether raw trait values may rely on an upstream invariant. Infinities, all producers, mutations, and network admission remain open. The prior 059 reviewer explicitly left NaN/positive-health admission pending.
findings.connections: Actual autoresolve can_attack_melee projects equipment to the melee weapon and holding side first, then calls the same capability. Tactical ingress gets a hand-specific view and also calls it; tactical Limbs and strategic CharacterLimbs return their respective fields. These are source connections only; none establishes an invalid normal input or live outcome.
findings.historical_relation: 059 Segovb READ-L11-453 leaves positive-health/NaN native admission and producers open. 774 CAMERA-INITIAL07-CONTRACT-043 traces the selected side and current body predicate, distinguishing it from broader retained capabilities; no unique finding for this exact input is asserted by that contract. CAMERA-INITIAL07-F031 concerns a distinct historical stale injury-to-health projection, not evidence of this nonfinite path. Central must reconcile any broader existing admission record before deciding an alias/count.
findings.future_direction: Determine canonical limb-health admission, representation and invalid-value policy across actual producers and consumers; if nonfinite state is supported or can cross a required boundary, reject it at its proper owner or propagate an explicit typed failure without inventing an offhand transfer or alternate fatigue penalty. Implementation and validation are outside this audit.

nonfindings_and_narrowing.detail: Melee capability distinguishes no selected side, disabled arm with the arm identity, and available. For Both, either selected arm at <=0 disables; deliberately no inferred offhand transfer. Action capability and broad character capability are different epochs/scope, not proven redundant authority.

WearableProtection describes one layer, LayeredArmor an aggregate and ArmorSurface a selected contact. The default aggregate adapter intentionally supplies None identity/material; tactical inventory selects a layer surface. Optional identity alone is not a defect. Source does not establish every producer, successful receipt or sample policy.

LoadoutSlot is the deliberate subset for initial anchors and total one-way conversion into the broader EquipmentLocation; the enum match is exhaustive for its own variants. The melee iteration diagnostic chooses a disabled arm from melee_holding_side then queries the unprojected CombatEquipment. The separate actual autoresolve receiver uses for_melee() first. The inspected authored_equipment builder sets weapon and melee_weapon together and leaves both side values at the same Right default, so the inspected construction does not show a mismatch. Different independently admitted equipment, other builder paths and diagnostic use remain open; do not assert an accepted mismatch or new finding from field duplication alone.

thirteen_lens_dispositions.disposition: Typed enum variants restrict labels; raw f32 health and armor values are not by themselves admission certificates. NaN conditional remains open.
Health and selected side jointly classify capability; wearable, aggregate and contact-surface facts have different stages and must not be conflated.
No change made. Retain specified offhand action, available/no-side/disabled distinctions and role-specific surface semantics if repair is later authorized.
SimpleAttribute, MeleeAttackStyle and LoadoutSlot use ordinary derives; their explicit cross-type conversion preserves a narrower input set.
MeleeAttackCapability owns disabled arm payload in its variant. No supported extra enum payload requirement established.
774 F009 already covers two seven-part owner taxonomies; map remains in current separately registered support.
The <=0 capability gate is not a finiteness check; LayeredArmor helper clamps some local inputs and sums other measures; actual upstream validity remains open.
Zero is the capability disability threshold. The domain and native admission for health and protection require actual producer policy, not mechanically wrapping all f32 values.
Scoped wire renames and diagnostic text are boundary/label representations; no unowned product string issue shown in assigned ranges.
Autoresolve explicitly projects the selected melee weapon and side before the shared capability. Tactical selected-hand view feeds the same shared predicate; full producer paths are not exhausted.

Melee action capability is derived from selected equipment and body; prior camera review distinguishes broad retained capabilities. Layered armor and contact selected surface are distinct projections.
Initial loadout subset and full equipment topology, simple and limb attributes, and generic attack style each have distinct purpose; no blanket collapse.
Seven-part taxonomy owner F009 and raw health admission owner need separate reconciliation; optional surface material/id may represent deliberate aggregate or innate data.
